instruction.name: xvfrstpi.h
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, find the first negative 16-bit element in `b`. Write its index into the lane of `a` selected by `imm` modulo 8, or write the maximum valid index plus one if no such element exists. Other elements of `a` remain unchanged.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvfrstpi.h $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvfrstpi.h $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvfrstpi.h $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvfrstpi.h $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvfrstpi.h $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvfrstpi.h $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvfrstpi.h $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvfrstpi.h $xr7, $xr15, 1
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvfrstpi.h $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvfrstpi.h $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvfrstpi.h $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvfrstpi.h $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvfrstpi.h $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvfrstpi.h $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvfrstpi.h $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvfrstpi.h $xr7, $xr15, 1'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 3.99 cycles. The measured CPI 0.4988 is the nominal 0.5 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LASX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with integer vector operands.
